report.question:
extract-agent-round-runner, task 2.3 (Claude describe + settings schema): the plan contradicts itself about "the three bounds".

What the plan promises: the requirement "Claude describe" (specs/executor/claude-dialect/spec.md:10-14), proposal FR7 and design D6 ("bounds replace roundTimeout's special status") say the Claude settings schema accepts allowedTools, disallowedTools, maxTurns, roundTimeout AND "the three bounds" (startup read, silence, overall — NFR-R1).

What the landed code and this same design say: application/.../app/describe/ProgramBounds.java:15-19 — "The bounds are the factory's, not the executor's (an executor that set its own would set the bound meant to contain it) and not the law's (no law field names them in this version)"; the only production source of request bounds is ProgramBounds.hints() (ProgramBounds.java:54), DEFAULTS bound once at the composition root. Design D11 of this change repeats it for the pending bounds ("set by neither the law nor describe, for the reason D3 gives"). No key names for the three bounds exist in openspec/ or the code. The runner (task 1.2) already takes all three bounds from the factory's ProgramBounds and passes them to the CLI as hints.

State: everything else of 2.3 is done and verified (describe: roles, capabilities, TOOL_GATE, five credentials via ChildEnvAllowlist, egress host from ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, repo-policy flags; AgentAiSeam deleted -> claude/ClaudeEnvironment; Claude key list -> claude/ClaudeSettings with additionalProperties:false; one roundTimeout shape owner adapters/.../settings/RoundTimeout; located-error spec; ClaudeCredentialDeliverySpec identity spec). Tasks 1.1-2.2 are ticked. 2.3 is left unticked only for the three bound keys; details in temporary-docs/gnomish/github-oinsio-gnomish-factory-129/implement.md.

Ranked by failure class: accepting the keys with no consumer would be a silent no-op (worst); letting them override the factory bounds contradicts ProgramBounds' containment rationale; dropping them from the schema changes a requirement and so needs a design decision (/architect Mode C + /opsx:update), which this stage may not make.

Recommendation: option 1 — amend FR7 / D6 / the requirement so the three bounds stay factory-owned (hints on the request, not schema keys); the schema keeps the four legacy keys. roundTimeout stays as today's per-stage overall bound.
options: 1. Amend the plan: the three bounds stay factory-owned (ProgramBounds, rendered as request hints); remove "and the three bounds" from FR7, D6 and the "Claude describe" requirement; tick 2.3 as implemented

2. Add law keys for the three bounds to the Claude schema that may only NARROW the factory's bounds (min of law value and factory bound), with names to be decided (e.g. startupReadTimeout, silenceTimeout, overallTimeout) and an amended D6 recording why this does not breach ProgramBounds' containment rule
3. Something else (describe it); the change waits for an /architect Mode C review of D6
